articles.title: CG Power , NTPC Green, Oswal Pumps, Jyoti, NBCC, Prestige Estates, Stanley Lifestyle among 15 stocks will hog limelight in Monday’s trade
articles.summary: CG Semi Private Limited, a joint venture involving India's Murugappa Group, Renesas Electronics, and Stars Microelectronics, has been established. This strategic collaboration aims to significantly bolster India's semiconductor ecosystem. Such initiatives are crucial for national technological self-reliance and economic growth, offering key opportunities in advanced manufacturing.

articles.title: Why So Lucky In Weights?
articles.summary: The website InTheWeights.Com rates individuals on a 0-1000 scale, assessing their recognition by Large Language Models (LLMs). The article highlights how the author received an unusually high rating, indicating a significant digital footprint and strong LLM familiarity compared to many. This platform offers a novel way to quantify one's online presence through the lens of artificial intelligence, showcasing AI's growing role in evaluating digital identities.

articles.title: Canada to decide between German, South Korean submarine bids on Monday
articles.summary: Canada is poised to select between German and South Korean bids for a monumental defence procurement: a fleet of 12 submarines. Expected Monday, this decision marks one of Canada's largest-ever military acquisitions. The choice will significantly bolster its naval capabilities and forge crucial strategic partnerships, with Germany's ThyssenKrupp Marine among the contenders.

articles.title: Canada to decide between German, South Korean submarine bids on Monday
articles.summary: Canada is poised to select between German and South Korean bids for a significant procurement of 12 new submarines. This multi-billion-dollar acquisition marks one of Canada's largest military investments, crucial for modernizing its naval capabilities, enhancing Arctic sovereignty, and strengthening maritime defence. The decision will impact strategic partnerships and provide substantial industrial benefits to the winning nation.
